reviews.text:
Honest, knowledgeable and great service!
Our pool/spa heater wasn't working. We hired another company, they came out, didn't bother to do any work on the heater, immediately told us our heater is old and needs to be replaced, $4000!
Kraig from Clearly Perfect Pool checked it out for us. He told us what the problem was, tried to find a used part since they don't make any new parts for our heater because it's old. He couldn't find any, but managed to order a part that would make the fan work.
He came back again, replaced it, made it work then fixed another connection issue we were having to control it from the app for no extra charge. His bill was more than reasonable and his honesty is very rare to find these days. We appreciate the help, honesty and hard work Kraig put into this. We would never ask another company for services anymore, Clearly Perfect Pool is who we will contact for any issues we may have going forward.

Jessy and Joseph Harb.
reviews.author: Jessy Harb

reviews.text:
I would give zero stars if it were an option. I made an appointment with Clearly Perfect Pools to get an estimate on cleaning services.  I had to cancel the morning of the appointment; no one answered, so I left a message letting them know I needed to cancel.
They sent someone out anyway; it's possible they didn't listen to their messages. I didn't go to the door when he knocked. But instead of leaving, this man proceeded to enter my backyard  through a closed gate. When I went out and told him that he had no business being in my yard, he proceeded to argue that he had an appointment and he was supposed to be there.
I don't know how this company runs a pool service but doesn't understand that you don't enter a gated yard without express permission of the homeowner, which was absolutely not given. That's trespassing. When someone does not answer when you knock on their door, you leave. Period.
reviews.author: Keitha Gregory

reviews.text: Have had Clearly Perfect Pools work on my pool for many years and they have always sorted my problems. They were generally able to react to my emergency needs quickly either same day or next day. I never felt that they were attempting to push an upsell and they always provided  options when I needed service.
reviews.author: Duane Abrams

reviews.text: This is a family run business and they are very honest & efficient. They are used to entering backyards to give quotes and or service without the owners being home. Knocking on a door first is a courtesy. Most businesses require 24 hour notice for cancellations or they charge a fee. Great service, friendly and respectful people. Always willing to work with you on the high prices of pool repairs.
reviews.author: Mandi Combs
